## Page intent analyzer
Send a URL, get back what the page is about, who it targets, its search intent and funnel stage, the keywords it goes after, and the questions it leaves open. Everything runs on your own computer through Ollama.

**Try it** (after you Publish):
```
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/page-intent \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"url": "https://www.enzuzo.com/pricing"}'
```
Add `"model": "qwen3.5:9b"` to pick a model. Otherwise it uses the first chat model you've pulled.

Edit the prompt and the fields you get back in **Build prompt**.
